description: Early decay time (conventions: Early decay time; ADR 0181).

cases.source: h = 0.99^n, 3000 samples at 1 kHz: exact tail, slope over 0 <= n < 115; close to -3/(fs log10 0.99) = 0.687 s
h = 0.25 * 0.995^n at 8 kHz: the scale cancels; close to -3/(fs log10 0.995)
h = 0.99^n e^(0.3jn): |h| is the single case's, so the same EDT
a fast decay plus a weak slow one: the exact tail of the sum with its cross term; the early fit is steeper than the late decay
the decay ends at 10 log10(0.81/1.81) > -10 dB
only sample 0 lies above -10 dB: fewer than two samples
case complex times 2^1000: squares of the samples overflow a double, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
case complex times 2^-960: squares of the samples underflow to 0, but the measure is a ratio of energies, so the same value
